reuse.why: Holidays are threaded into the existing WeekendRule/applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the new handler reuses recurConfigToRSchedule and applyWeekendRule.

duplication.why: The daily-skip rule is re-decided at every caller: getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template each compute skipsWeekendOccurrences, filter weekend/holiday days themselves and pass skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendDays, while getNextDate has its own branch.

placement.why: Weekend/holiday shifting lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip decision sits outside the WeekendRule abstraction in the server callers.

scope.why: All edits serve weekend skipping, the date-range handler and holidays.

maintainability.why: A maintainer must remember to repeat the skipsWeekendOccurrences filter plus the masked skipWeekend flag at every new caller, and schedule-template's flipped noSkipWeekend is hard to follow.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange and budget/schedule-template.ts implement the daily weekend/holiday skip around applyWeekendRule instead of inside the WeekendRule

disguised_duplication.where: the 'skip if daily and isWeekendOrHoliday, else applyWeekendRule with skipWeekend && !skipsWeekendDays' logic is repeated in reshaped forms (filter chain, for-loop continue, flag masking, getNextWeekdayOccurrence)

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gain holidays; getNextDate gains a daily special-case branch; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template re-implement the daily skip
